# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 3: Playable Jurchen/Manchu Eight Banners & Shanhaiguan (oe_pmch_, Slot 80). Generated by gen_playable_manchu.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_manchu_pass = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_oe_sit_manchu_pass

	can_start = {
		oe_start_is_1337 = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_started }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_ended }
		OR = {
			has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_force_start
			AND = {
				current_year >= 1580
				current_year <= 1680
				oe_pmch_contender_ready = yes
				OR = {
					AND = { country_exists = c:MNG c:MNG = { oe_pmch_defender_stressed = yes } }
					AND = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { oe_pmch_defender_stressed = yes } }
					AND = { country_exists = c:YUA c:YUA = { oe_pmch_defender_stressed = yes } }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			oe_pmch_is_host = yes
			oe_pmch_is_central_plains_defender = yes
			tag = KOR
			tag = JAP
			tag = RUS
			tag = MOS
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					region = region:north_china_region
					region = region:manchuria_region
					region = region:mongolia_region
					region = region:korea_region
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Breakthrough through Shanhaiguan -> Proclaim Great Qing (stays tag = MCH!)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_manchu_pass_conquest"
		desc = "oe_sit_manchu_pass_conquest_desc"
		trigger = {
			oe_pmch_pass_conquest_achieved = yes
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_ended value = 1 }
			oe_pmch_resolve_conquest_outcome = yes
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Guanning Wall Holds for 15 Years or Shenyang/Liaoyang Lost
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_manchu_pass_repelled"
		desc = "oe_sit_manchu_pass_repelled_desc"
		trigger = {
			oe_pmch_pass_repelled_achieved = yes
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_ended value = 2 }
			oe_pmch_resolve_repelled_outcome = yes
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Great Wall Partition & Liaodong Horse-Market Truce
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_manchu_pass_stalemate"
		desc = "oe_sit_manchu_pass_stalemate_desc"
		trigger = {
			oe_pmch_pass_stalemate_achieved = yes
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_ended value = 3 }
			oe_pmch_resolve_stalemate_outcome = yes
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_started value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_months value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_pressure value = 30 }
		oe_pmch_on_pass_started = yes
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_months }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_months add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_months value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					current_month = 1
					current_month = 7
				}
			}
			oe_pmch_pass_biannual_sync = yes
		}
	}

	on_ended = { }

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_pmch_is_host = yes }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_pmch_map_manchu_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					this = location:funing
					this = location:lulong
					this = location:ningyuan_jinzhou
					this = location:jinzhou_liaoyang
					this = location:dadu
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_pmch_map_pass_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_pmch_is_central_plains_defender = yes }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_pmch_map_defender_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = {
					OR = {
						tag = KOR
						tag = JAP
						tag = RUS
						tag = MOS
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_pmch_map_observer_tt
		}
	}

	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { oe_pmch_is_host = yes }
			}
			value = owner.country_color
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					this = location:funing
					this = location:lulong
					this = location:ningyuan_jinzhou
					this = location:jinzhou_liaoyang
					this = location:dadu
				}
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { oe_pmch_is_central_plains_defender = yes }
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_LOW
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = KOR
						tag = JAP
						tag = RUS
						tag = MOS
					}
				}
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}
}
